tasks.title: The Drone Interceptor's orbit-and-dash and the Open Space Patrol Drone's drift are pinned by tests
tasks.description: See docs/plans/cmufklb100001p92xs1ey2fb1/3-plan.md §3 step 3, §4 rows test_drone_interceptor.gd and test_patrol_drone.gd. Characterization. Drone Interceptor: zero velocity with no player; ENTER at approach_speed toward the player; switches to ORBIT at <= orbit_radius; orbit correction speed clamped to [60, orbit_correct_speed]; the dash starts when its timer expires; the dash direction uses player.velocity * dash_prediction_time; dash_speed; contact sets health to 0; facing converges nose-up toward the target. Seed the global RNG inside the test. PatrolDrone: drift = initial_direction * move_speed; a zero direction falls back to RIGHT; scene-wired damage decreases health; health 0 → died + freed. Pin, marked as characterization of a bug: HurtBox mask == 64 (the player's rockets pass through it) and body layer 256. These tests become the port's acceptance test in t14-port-interceptor.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:

tasks.title: Enemies have one reliable way to know where the player is and where they will be, including when a shot cannot catch them
tasks.description: See docs/plans/cmufklb100001p92xs1ey2fb1/3-plan.md §2.6 and P-11. Add global/enemy_ai/target_info.gd (class_name TargetInfo extends RefCounted). It is a snapshot with has_target, position, velocity, facing, distance_from, relative_angle_from and predicted_position(t). intercept(from, shot_speed) returns {ok, point, time} using the closed-form quadratic, with ok=false when there is no positive root, when shot_speed is 0, or when there is no target. aim_direction(from, shot_speed, accuracy) blends direct aim (0) with intercept aim (1); a failed intercept falls back to direct; with no target it returns Vector2.DOWN. line_of_sight(from) is a stub returning has_target (the real raycast is phase 4). static player(tree) is the single player resolver; static of(node). Unit tests: tests/unit/test_target_info.gd with every case in the plan's §4 row.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
- Boundary cases: a target outrunning the shot → ok false; a target at the shooter's position → no NaN; a target freed after the snapshot → safe.
- accuracy 0/0.5/1 give direct/midpoint/intercept. The existing gates stay green (config isolation, contact-damage, contact-hitbox and hurtbox geometry, player-bullet lifetime, signal arity, project load integrity, station family). `bash /agent/verify.sh` passes.

tasks.title: In Assault, AI-driven enemies stay inside the play corridor with soft edges, and can still fly in from off-screen without being teleported
tasks.description: See docs/plans/cmufklb100001p92xs1ey2fb1/3-plan.md §2.5, P-7 and P-13. Add assault/scenes/systems/assault_corridor_constraint.gd (extends MovementConstraint). The visible rect is derived from ArenaCamera constants (x −100…1380, y −380…1100). The soft band is 120 px with inward pressure growing with depth; the hard band is 450 px, with outward components removed so the enemy slides and never stalls. The not-yet-entered rule keeps only the inward component, or supplies a minimum inward speed, until the entered latch sets. Also add is_past_cull(pos), reproducing the Drone Interceptor's legacy cull (camera global_position ± viewport/2 ± 80). ArenaCamera joins group &"assault_arena" and gains enemy_movement_constraint() (a new instance each call) and projectile_world_rect() (the derived rect + 64 px = today's EnemyBullet bounds). EnemyMover AUTO mode resolves the constraint from that group; with no provider there is no constraint. Unit tests: tests/unit/test_assault_corridor_constraint.gd.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
- Boundary: a spawn above the screen with outward intent gets a strictly inward velocity until it enters, and the latch then holds.
- Beyond the hard band the tangential component is kept.
- The derived rect equals ArenaCamera's constants, and projectile_world_rect() equals x −164…1444, y −444…1164.
- No file under global/ references the ArenaCamera class. The existing gates stay green (config isolation, contact-damage, contact-hitbox and hurtbox geometry, player-bullet lifetime, signal arity, project load integrity, station family). `bash /agent/verify.sh` passes.

tasks.title: The Drone Interceptor runs on the new AI architecture: it plays the same in Assault and now also hunts the player in Open Space
tasks.description: See docs/plans/cmufklb100001p92xs1ey2fb1/3-plan.md §2.11 and P-8.
